description: Step 1 of 2 to save a new recipient. Use get_recipient_requirements first for the right `type` and `details` keys. Nothing is written to Wise yet: this returns a summary and a one-time confirmation_code. Show the summary to the user and call confirm_action ONLY if the user explicitly approves it in their next message.

account_holder_name.description: Recipient's full name or business name

currency.description: Currency of the recipient's account, e.g. EUR

details.description: Fields from get_recipient_requirements, e.g. {"legalType":"PRIVATE","iban":"DE89..."}; nested keys like address.city as objects

owned_by_me.description: True if this is the user's own account elsewhere

profile.description: Profile id from list_profiles, "personal", "business" or part of the profile name

type.description: Requirement type, e.g. iban, sort_code, aba

name: prepare_recipient

summary.description: Show this to the user before confirming

title: Prepare a new Wise recipient
